tools.name: pine_integrity
tools.description: Check TradingView Pine Script v5/v6 for structures that make backtests look better than live trading: future data (lookahead_on without offset), unconfirmed higher-timeframe values, signals drawn on past bars, realtime-only state, fill and cost assumptions, alerts on unconfirmed bars. Returns verdic

tools.name: pine_lint
tools.description: Lint TradingView Pine Script: version annotation, declaration, brackets, strings, v4 remnants in v5/v6 code, undeclared reassignment, limits, plus all integrity checks.

tools.name: backtest_reconcile
tools.description: Recompute net profit, win rate, profit factor and closed-trade drawdown from a TradingView 'List of trades' CSV or a JSON trade list with commission settings, and mark each claimed metric MATCH or MISMATCH.

tools.name: kr_figure_check
tools.description: Check the numbers in a Korean finance text against official sources: percent vs percentage point, 조/억 units, Bank of Korea base rate and KTB yields, KRW exchange rates, listed-company revenue/operating profit/net income from DART (consolidated vs separate).

tools.name: dart_correction_impact
tools.description: For a Korean listed company: which cited DART filings were later corrected or withdrawn, and which numbers or dates in a report equal a corrected value (STALE), with the corrected value and filing.

tools.name: kr_rates
tools.description: Official Korean interest rates on a date: BoK base rate, call, KOFR, CD, CP, MSB, KTB 1y-50y and spreads, each with its observation date.

tools.name: kr_fx
tools.description: KRW exchange rates from the Export-Import Bank of Korea: deal basis, telegraphic buying and selling rates.

tools.name: kr_law_article
tools.description: One article of a Korean statute quoted verbatim with paragraphs and items, promulgation and enforcement dates and the official link. Accepts official names, abbreviations (자본시장법) and common English names.

tools.name: kr_apartment_trades
tools.description: Korean apartment sale prices from the MOLIT real-transaction register by district and month, trends and single complexes. Ask in Korean or English.

tools.name: dart_events
tools.description: Korean listed-company disclosures from OpenDART: filings, corrections linked to originals with before/after values, point-in-time view. Ask in Korean or English.

tools.name: kr_export_pulse
tools.description: South Korea's export statistics from Korea Customs Service: 10-day provisional totals, changes vs prior month and year, HS code and country trade.
